verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo awfoo bil-uqoodi uhillat lakum baheematul-an'aami illaa maa yutlaa alaykum ghayra muhillis-saydi wa antum hurumun innallaaha yahkumu maa yureed

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tuhilloo sha'aa'ira Allaahi wa lash-shahral-haraama wa lal-hadya wa lal-qalaa'ida wa laa aammeenal-baytal-haraama yabtaghoona fadlan min rabbihim wa ridwaanan wa idhaa halaltum fastaadoo wa laa yajrimannakum shana'aanu qawmin an saddookum anil-masjidil-haraami an ta'tadoo wa ta'aawanoo alal-birri wat-taqwaa wa laa ta'aawanoo alal-ithmi wal-udwaani wattaqoo Allaaha innallaaha shadeedul-iqaab

Hurrimat alaykumul-maytatu wad-damu wa lahmul-khinzeeri wa maa uhilla lighayri Allaahi bihi wal-munkhaniqatu wal-mawqoodhatu wal-mutaraddiyatu wan-nateehatu wa maa akalas-sabu'u illaa maa dhakkaytum wa maa dhubiha alan-nusubi wa an tastaqsimoo bil-azlaami dhaalikum fisqun al-yawma ya'isal-ladheena kafaroo min deenikum falaa takhshawhum wakhshawnil-yawma akmaltu lakum deenakum wa atmamtu alaykum ni'matee wa radeetu lakumul-islaama deenan famani udturra fee makhmasatin ghayra mutajaanifin l'ithmin fa-innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem

Yas'aloonaka maadhaa uhilla lahum qul uhilla lakumut-tayyibaatu wa maa allamtum minal-jawaarihi mukallibeena tu'allimoonahunna mimmaa allamakumu Allaahu fakuloo mimmaa amsakna alaykum wadhkuroo isma Allaahi alayhi wattaqoo Allaaha innallaaha saree'ul-hisaab

Al-yawma uhilla lakumut-tayyibaatu wa ta'aamul-ladheena ootul-kitaaba hillun lakum wa ta'aamukum hillun lahum wal-muhsanaatu minal-mu'minaati wal-muhsanaatu minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba min qablikum idhaa aataytumoohunna ujoorahunna muhsineena ghayra musaafiheena wa laa muttakhidhee akhdaanin wa man yakfur bil-eemaani faqad habita amaluhu wa huwa fil-aakhirati minal-khaasireen

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa qumtum ilas-salaati faghsiloo wujoohakum wa aydiyakum ilal-maraafiqi wamsahoo biru'oosikum wa arjulakum ilal-ka'bayni wa in kuntum junuban fattahharoo wa in kuntum mardaa aw alaa safarin aw jaa'a ahadun minkum minal-ghaa'iti aw laamastumun-nisaa falam tajidoo maa'an fatayammamoo sa'eedan tayyiban famsahoo biwujoohikum wa aydeekum minhu maa yureedu Allaahu liyaj'ala alaykum min harajin wa laakin yureedu liyutahhirakum waliyutimma ni'matahu alaykum la-allakum tashkuroon
Wadhkuroo ni'matallaahi alaykum wa meethaaqahul-ladhee wathaqakum bihi idh qultum sami'naa wa ata'naa wattaqoo Allaaha innallaaha aleemun bidhaatis-sudoor

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo koonoo qawwaameena Lillaahi shuhadaa'a bil-qisti wa laa yajrimannakum shana'aanu qawmin alaa allaa ta'diloo i'diloo huwa aqrabu lit-taqwaa wattaqoo Allaaha innallaaha khabeerun bimaa ta'maloon
Wa-ada Allaahul-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati lahum maghfiratun wa ajrun azeem
Wal-ladheena kafaroo wa kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa ulaa'ika ashaabul-jaheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo udhkuroo ni'matallaahi alaykum idh hamma qawmun an yabsutoo ilaykum aydiyahum fakaffa aydiyahum ankum wattaqoo Allaaha wa alaa Allaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon

Wa laqad akhadha Allaahu meethaaqa banee israa'eela wa ba'athnaa minhumu ithnay ashara naqeeban wa qaala Allaahu innee ma'akum la-in aqamtumus-salaata wa aataytumuz-zakaata wa aamantum birusulee wa azzartumoohum wa aqradtumu Allaaha qardan hasanan la-ukaffiranna ankum sayyi'aatikum wa la-udkhilannakum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru faman kafara ba'da dhaalika minkum faqad dalla sawaa'as-sabeel

Fabimaa naqdihim meethaaqahum la-annaahum wa ja'alnaa quloobahum qaasiyatan yuharrifoonal-kalima an mawaadi'ihi wa nasoo hazzan mimmaa dhukkiroo bihi wa laa tazaalu tattali'u alaa khaa'inatin minhum illaa qaleelan minhum fa'fu anhum wasfah innallaaha yuhibbul-muhsineen

Wa minal-ladheena qaaloo innaa nasaaraa akhadhnaa meethaaqahum fanasoo hazzan mimmaa dhukkiroo bihi fa-aghraynaa baynahumul-adaawata wal-baghdaa'a ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati wa sawfa yunabbi'uhumu Allaahu bimaa kaanoo yasna'oon
Yaa ahlal-kitaabi qad jaa'akum rasoolunaa yubayyinu lakum katheeran mimmaa kuntum tukhfoona minal-kitaabi wa ya'foo an katheerin qad jaa'akum mina Allaahi noorun wa kitaabun mubeen
Yahdee bihi Allaahu manit-taba'a ridwaanahu subulas-salaami wa yukhrijuhum minaz-zulumaati ilan-noori bi-idhnihi wa yahdeehim ilaa siraatin mustaqeem

Laqad kafaral-ladheena qaaloo innallaaha huwal-maseehu ubnu maryama qul faman yamliku mina Allaahi shay'an in araada an yuhlikal-maseeha ibna maryama wa ummahu wa man fil-ardi jamee'an wa Lillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa maa baynahumaa ykhluqu maa yashaa'u Wallaahu alaa kulli shay'in qadeer

Wa qaalatil-yahoodu wan-nasaaraa nahnu abnaa'u Allaahi wa ahibbaa'uuhu qul falima yu'adhdhibukum bidhunoobikum bal antum basharun mimman khalaqa yaghfiru liman yashaa'u wa yu'adhdhibu man yashaa'u wa Lillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa maa baynahumaa wa ilayhil-maseer

Yaa ahlal-kitaabi qad jaa'akum rasoolunaa yubayyinu lakum alaa fatratin minar-rusuli an taqooloo maa jaa'anaa min basheerin wa laa nadheerin faqad jaa'akum basheerun wa nadheerun Wallaahu alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
Wa idh qaala moosaa liqawmihi yaa qawmi udhkuroo ni'matallaahi alaykum idh ja'ala feekum anbiyaa'a wa ja'alakum mulookan wa aataakum maa lam yu'ti ahadan minal-aalameen
Yaa qawmi udkhulul-ardal-muqaddasatal-latee kataba Allaahu lakum wa laa tartaddoo alaa adbaarikum fatanqaliboo khaasireen
Qaaloo yaa moosaa inna feehaa qawman jabbaareena wa innaa lan nadkhulahaa hattaa yakhrujoo minhaa fa-in yakhrujoo minhaa fa-innaa daakhiloon
Qaala rajulaani minal-ladheena yakhaafoona an'ama Allaahu alayhimaa udkhuloo alayhimul-baaba fa-idhaa dakhaltumoohu fa-innakum ghaaliboona wa alaa Allaahi fatawakkaloo in kuntum mu'mineen
Qaaloo yaa moosaa innaa lan nadkhulahaa abadan maa daamoo feehaa fadhhab anta wa rabbuka faqaatilaa innaa haahunaa qaa'idoon
Qaala rabbi innee laa amliku illaa nafsee wa akhee fafruq baynanaa wa baynal-qawmil-faasiqeen
Qaala fa-innahaa muharramatun alayhim arba'eena sanatan yateehoona fil-ardi falaa ta'sa alal-qawmil-faasiqeen
Watlu alayhim naba'a ibnay aadama bil-haqqi idh qarrabaa qurbaanan fatuqubbila min ahadihimaa wa lam yutaqabbal minal-aakhari qaala la-aqtulannaka qaala innamaa yataqabbalu Allaahu minal-muttaqeen
La-in basatta ilayya yadaka litaqtulanee maa anaa bibaasitin yadiya ilayka li'qtulaka innee akhaafu Allaaha rabbal-aalameen
Innee ureedu an taboo'a bi-ithmee wa ithmika fatakoona min ashaabin-naari wa dhaalika jazaa'uz-zaalimeen
Fatawwa'at lahu nafsuhu qatla akheehi faqatalahu fa-asbaha minal-khaasireen

Faba'atha Allaahu ghuraaban yabhathu fil-ardi liyuriyahu kayfa yuwaaree saw'ata akheehi qaala yaa waylataa a'ajaztu an akoona mithla haadhal-ghuraabi fa-uwaariya saw'ata akhee fa-asbaha minan-naadimeen

Min ajli dhaalika katabnaa alaa banee israa'eela annahu man qatala nafsan bighayri nafsin aw fasaadin fil-ardi faka'annamaa qatalan-naasa jamee'an wa man ahyaahaa faka'annamaa ahyan-naasa jamee'an wa laqad jaa'athum rusulunaa bil-bayyinaati thumma inna katheeran minhum ba'da dhaalika fil-ardi lamusrifoon

Innamaa jazaa'ul-ladheena yuhaariboona Allaaha wa rasoolahu wa yas'awna fil-ardi fasaadan an yuqattaloo aw yusallaboo aw tuqatta'a aydeehim wa arjuluhum min khilaafin aw yunfaw minal-ardi dhaalika lahum khizyun fid-dunyaa wa lahum fil-aakhirati adhaabun azeem
Illal-ladheena taaboo min qabli an taqdiroo alayhim fa'lamoo annallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo ittaqoo Allaaha wabtaghoo ilayhil-waseelata wa jaahidoo fee sabeelihi la-allakum tuflihoon
Innal-ladheena kafaroo law anna lahum maa fil-ardi jamee'an wa mithlahu ma'ahu liyaftadoo bihi min adhaabi yawmil-qiyaamati maa tuqubbila minhum wa lahum adhaabun aleem
Yureedoona an yakhrujoo minan-naari wa maa hum bikhaarijeena minhaa wa lahum adhaabun muqeem
Was-saariqu was-saariqatu faqta'oo aydiyahumaa jazaa'an bimaa kasabaa nakaalan mina Allaahi Wallaahu azeezun hakeem
Faman taaba min ba'di zulmihi wa aslaha fa-innallaaha yatoobu alayhi innallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
Alam ta'lam annallaaha lahu mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi yu'adhdhibu man yashaa'u wa yaghfiru liman yashaa'u Wallaahu alaa kulli shay'in qadeer

Yaa ayyuhar-rasoolu laa yahzunkal-ladheena yusaari'oona fil-kufri minal-ladheena qaaloo aamannaa bi-afwaahihim wa lam tu'min quloobuhum wa minal-ladheena haadoo sammaa'oona lilkadhibi sammaa'oona liqawmin aakhareena lam ya'tooka yuharrifoonal-kalima min ba'di mawaadi'ihi yaqooloona in ooteetum haadhaa fakhudhoohu wa in lam tu'tawhu fahdharoo wa man yuridi Allaahu fitnatahu falan tamlika lahu mina Allaahi shay'an ulaa'ikal-ladheena lam yuridi Allaahu an yutahhira quloobahum lahum fid-dunyaa khizyun wa lahum fil-aakhirati adhaabun azeem

Sammaa'oona lilkadhibi akkaaloona lis-suhti fa-in jaa'ooka fahkum baynahum aw a'rid anhum wa in tu'rid anhum falan yadurrooka shay'an wa in hakamta fahkum baynahum bil-qisti innallaaha yuhibbul-muqsiteen
Wa kayfa yuhakkimoonaka wa indahumut-tawraatu feehaa hukmu Allaahi thumma yatawallawna min ba'di dhaalika wa maa ulaa'ika bil-mu'mineen

Innaa anzalnat-tawraata feehaa hudan wa noorun yahkumu bihan-nabiyyoonal-ladheena aslamoo lilladheena haadoo war-rabbaaniyyoona wal-ahbaaru bimas-tuhfizoo min kitaabillaahi wa kaanoo alayhi shuhadaa'a falaa takhshaw an-naasa wakhshawnee wa laa tashtaroo bi-aayaatee thamanan qaleelan wa man lam yahkum bimaa anzala Allaahu fa-ulaa'ika humul-kaafiroon

Wa katabnaa alayhim feehaa annan-nafsa bin-nafsi wal-ayna bil-ayni wal-anfa bil-anfi wal-udhuna bil-udhuni was-sinna bis-sinni wal-jurooha qisaasun faman tasaddaqa bihi fahuwa kaffaaratun lahu wa man lam yahkum bimaa anzala Allaahu fa-ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon

Wa qaffaynaa alaa aathaarihim bi-eesaa ibni maryama musaddiqan limaa bayna yadayhi minat-tawraati wa aataynaahul-injeela feehi hudan wa noorun wa musaddiqan limaa bayna yadayhi minat-tawraati wa hudan wa maw'izatan lilmuttaqeen
Wa lyahkum ahlul-injeeli bimaa anzala Allaahu feehi wa man lam yahkum bimaa anzala Allaahu fa-ulaa'ika humul-faasiqoon

Wa anzalnaa ilaykal-kitaaba bil-haqqi musaddiqan limaa bayna yadayhi minal-kitaabi wa muhayminan alayhi fahkum baynahum bimaa anzala Allaahu wa laa tattabi ahwaa'ahum ammaa jaa'aka minal-haqqi likullin ja'alnaa minkum shir'atan wa minhaajan wa law shaa'a Allaahu laja'alakum ummatan waahidatan wa laakin liyabluwakum fee maa aataakum fastabiqul-khayraati ilaa Allaahi marji'ukum jamee'an fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum feehi takhtalifoon

Wa anih-kum baynahum bimaa anzala Allaahu wa laa tattabi ahwaa'ahum wahdharhum an yaftinooka an ba'di maa anzala Allaahu ilayka fa-in tawallaw fa'lam annamaa yureedu Allaahu an yuseebahum biba'di dhunoobihim wa inna katheeran minan-naasi lafaasiqoon
Afahukmal-jaahiliyyati yabghoona wa man ahsanu mina Allaahi hukman liqawmin yooqinoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattakhidhul-yahooda wan-nasaaraa awliyaa'a ba'duhum awliyaa'u ba'din wa man yatawallahum minkum fa-innahu minhum innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen

Fataral-ladheena fee quloobihim maradun yusaari'oona feehim yaqooloona nakhshaa an tuseebanaa daa'iratun fa-asaa Allaahu an ya'tiya bil-fathi aw amrin min indihi fayusbihoo alaa maa asarroo fee anfusihim naadimeen
Wa yaqoolul-ladheena aamanoo ahaa'uulaa al-ladheena aqsamoo Billaahi jahda aymaanihim innahum lama'akum habitat a'maaluhum fa-asbahoo khaasireen

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo man yartadda minkum an deenihi fasawfa ya'tee Allaahu biqawmin yuhibbuhum wa yuhibboonahu adhillatin alal-mu'mineena a'izzatin alal-kaafireena yujaahidoona fee sabeelillaahi wa laa yakhaafoona lawmata laa'imin dhaalika fadlu Allaahi yu'teehi man yashaa'u Wallaahu waasi'un aleem
Innamaa waliyyukumu Allaahu wa rasooluhu wal-ladheena aamanul-ladheena yuqeemoonas-salaata wa yu'toonaz-zakaata wa hum raaki'oon
Wa man yatawalla Allaaha wa rasoolahu wal-ladheena aamanoo fa-inna hizba Allaahi humul-ghaaliboon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattakhidhul-ladheena ittakhadhoo deenakum huzuwan wa la-iban minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba min qablikum wal-kuffaara awliyaa'a wattaqoo Allaaha in kuntum mu'mineen
Wa idhaa naadaytum ilas-salaati ittakhadhoohaa huzuwan wa la-iban dhaalika bi-annahum qawmun laa ya'qiloon
Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi hal tanqimoona minnaa illaa an aamannaa Billaahi wa maa unzila ilaynaa wa maa unzila min qablu wa anna aktharakum faasiqoon

Qul hal unabbi'ukum bisharrin min dhaalika mathoobatan indallaahi man la-anahu Allaahu wa ghadiba alayhi wa ja'ala minhumul-qiradata wal-khanaazeera wa abadat-taaghoota ulaa'ika sharrun makaanan wa adallu an sawaa'is-sabeel
Wa idhaa jaa'ookum qaaloo aamannaa wa qad dakhaloo bil-kufri wa hum qad kharajoo bihi Wallaahu a'lamu bimaa kaanoo yaktumoon
Wa taraa katheeran minhum yusaari'oona fil-ithmi wal-udwaani wa aklihimus-suhta labi'sa maa kaanoo ya'maloon
Lawlaa yanhaahumur-rabbaaniyyoona wal-ahbaaru an qawlihimul-ithma wa aklihimus-suhta labi'sa maa kaanoo yasna'oon

Wa qaalatil-yahoodu yadu Allaahi maghloolatun ghullat aydeehim wa lu'inoo bimaa qaaloo bal yadaahu mabsootataani yunfiqu kayfa yashaa'u wa layazeedanna katheeran minhum maa unzila ilayka min rabbika tughyaanan wa kufran wa alqaynaa baynahumul-adaawata wal-baghdaa'a ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati kullamaa awqadoo naaran lilharbi atfa'ahaa Allaahu wa yas'awna fil-ardi fasaadan Wallaahu laa yuhibbul-mufsideen
Wa law anna ahlal-kitaabi aamanoo wattaqaw lakaffarnaa anhum sayyi'aatihim wa la-adkhalnaahum jannaatin-na'eem
Wa law annahum aqaamut-tawraata wal-injeela wa maa unzila ilayhim min rabbihim la-akaloo min fawqihim wa min tahti arjulihim minhum ummatun muqtasidatun wa katheerun minhum saa'a maa ya'maloon
Yaa ayyuhar-rasoolu balligh maa unzila ilayka min rabbika wa in lam taf'al famaa ballaghta risaalatahu Wallaahu ya'simuka minan-naasi innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmal-kaafireen

Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi lastum alaa shay'in hattaa tuqeemut-tawraata wal-injeela wa maa unzila ilaykum min rabbikum wa layazeedanna katheeran minhum maa unzila ilayka min rabbika tughyaanan wa kufran falaa ta'sa alal-qawmil-kaafireen
Innal-ladheena aamanoo wal-ladheena haadoo was-saabi'oona wan-nasaaraa man aamana Billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa amila saalihan falaa khawfun alayhim wa laa hum yahzanoon
Laqad akhadhnaa meethaaqa banee israa'eela wa arsalnaa ilayhim rusulan kullamaa jaa'ahum rasoolun bimaa laa tahwaa anfusuhum fareeqan kadhdhaboo wa fareeqan yaqtuloon
Wa hasiboo allaa takoona fitnatun fa-amoo wa sammoo thumma taaba Allaahu alayhim thumma amoo wa sammoo katheerun minhum Wallaahu baseerun bimaa ya'maloon

Laqad kafaral-ladheena qaaloo innallaaha huwal-maseehu ubnu maryama wa qaalal-maseehu yaa banee israa'eela u'budoo Allaaha rabbee wa rabbakum innahu man yushrik Billaahi faqad harrama Allaahu alayhil-jannata wa ma'waahun-naaru wa maa liz-zaalimeena min ansaar
Laqad kafaral-ladheena qaaloo innallaaha thaalithu thalaathatin wa maa min ilaahin illaa ilaahun waahidun wa in lam yantahoo ammaa yaqooloona layamassannal-ladheena kafaroo minhum adhaabun aleem
Afalaa yatooboona ilaa Allaahi wa yastaghfiroonahu Wallaahu ghafoorun Raheem
Mal-maseehu ubnu maryama illaa rasoolun qad khalat min qablihir-rusulu wa ummuhu siddeeqatun kaanaa ya'kulaanit-ta'aama unzur kayfa nubayyinu lahumul-aayaati thumma unzur annaa yu'ufakoon
Qul ata'budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yamliku lakum darran wa laa naf'an Wallaahu huwas-samee'ul-aleem
Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi laa taghloo fee deenikum ghayral-haqqi wa laa tattabi'oo ahwaa'a qawmin qad dalloo min qablu wa adalloo katheeran wa dalloo an sawaa'is-sabeel
Lu'inal-ladheena kafaroo min banee israa'eela alaa lisaani daawooda wa eesab-ni maryama dhaalika bimaa asaw wa kaanoo ya'tadoon
Kaanoo laa yatanaahawna an munkarin fa-aloohu labi'sa maa kaanoo yaf'aloon
Taraa katheeran minhum yatawallawnal-ladheena kafaroo labi'sa maa qaddamat lahum anfusuhum an sakhita Allaahu alayhim wa fil-adhaabi hum khaalidoon
Wa law kaanoo yu'minoona Billaahi wan-nabiyyi wa maa unzila ilayhi mat-takhadhoohum awliyaa'a wa laakinna katheeran minhum faasiqoon

Latajidanna ashaddan-naasi adaawatan lilladheena aamanul-yahooda wal-ladheena ashrakoo wa latajidanna aqrabahum mawaddatan lilladheena aamanul-ladheena qaaloo innaa nasaaraa dhaalika bi-anna minhum qisseeseena wa ruhbaanan wa annahum laa yastakbiroon
Wa idhaa sami'oo maa unzila ilar-rasooli taraa a'yunahum tafeedu minad-dam'i mimmaa arafoo minal-haqqi yaqooloona rabbanaa aamannaa faktubnaa ma'ash-shaahideen
Wa maa lanaa laa nu'minu Billaahi wa maa jaa'anaa minal-haqqi wa natma'u an yudkhilanaa rabbunaa ma'al-qawmis-saaliheen
Fa-athaabahumu Allaahu bimaa qaaloo jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa wa dhaalika jazaa'ul-muhsineen
Wal-ladheena kafaroo wa kadhdhaboo bi-aayaatinaa ulaa'ika ashaabul-jaheem
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tuharrimoo tayyibaati maa ahalla Allaahu lakum wa laa ta'tadoo innallaaha laa yuhibbul-mu'tadeen
Wa kuloo mimmaa razaqakumu Allaahu halaalan tayyiban wattaqoo Allaahal-ladhee antum bihi mu'minoon

Laa yu'uaakhidhukumu Allaahu bil-laghwi fee aymaanikum wa laakin yu'uaakhidhukum bimaa aqqadtumul-eemaana fakaffaaratuhu it'aamu asharati masaakeena min awsati maa tut'imoona ahleekum aw kiswatuhum aw tahreeru raqabatin faman lam yajid fasiyaamu thalaathati ayyaamin dhaalika kaffaaratu aymaanikum idhaa halaftum wahfazoo aymaanakum kadhaalika yubayyinu Allaahu lakum aayaatihi la-allakum tashkuroon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo innamal-khamru wal-maysiru wal-ansaabu wal-azlaamu rijsun min amalish-shaytaani fajtaniboohu la-allakum tuflihoon
Innamaa yureedush-shaytaanu an yooqi'a baynakumul-adaawata wal-baghdaa'a fil-khamri wal-maysiri wa yasuddakum an dhikri Allaahi wa anis-salaati fahal antum muntahoon
Wa atee'oo Allaaha wa atee'ur-rasoola wahdharoo fa-in tawallaytum fa'lamoo annamaa alaa rasoolinal-balaaghul-mubeen

Laysa alal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati junaahun feemaa ta'imoo idhaa mat-taqaw wa aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati thumma ittaqaw wa aamanoo thumma ittaqaw wa ahsanoo Wallaahu yuhibbul-muhsineen

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo layabluwannakumu Allaahu bishay'in minas-saydi tanaaluhu aydeekum wa rimaahukum liya'lama Allaahu man yakhaafuhu bil-ghaybi famani i'tadaa ba'da dhaalika falahu adhaabun aleem

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa taqtulus-sayda wa antum hurumun wa man qatalahu minkum muta'ammidan fajazaa'un mithlu maa qatala minan-na'ami yahkumu bihi dhawaa adlin minkum hadyan baalighal-ka'bati aw kaffaaratun ta'aamu masaakeena aw adlu dhaalika siyaaman liyadhooqa wabaala amrihi afaa Allaahu ammaa salafa wa man aada fayantaqimu Allaahu minhu Wallaahu azeezun dhun-tiqaam
Uhilla lakum saydul-bahri wa ta'aamuhu mataa'an lakum wa lis-sayyaarati wa hurrima alaykum saydul-barri maa dumtum huruman wattaqoo Allaahal-ladhee ilayhi tuhsharoon

Ja'ala Allaahul-ka'batal-baytal-haraama qiyaaman lin-naasi wash-shahral-haraama wal-hadya wal-qalaa'ida dhaalika lita'lamoo annallaaha ya'lamu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi wa annallaaha bikulli shay'in aleem
I'lamoo annallaaha shadeedul-iqaabi wa annallaaha ghafoorun Raheem
Maa alar-rasooli illal-balaaghu Wallaahu ya'lamu maa tubdoona wa maa taktumoon
Qul laa yastawil-khabeethu wat-tayyibu wa law a'jabaka kathratul-khabeethi fattaqoo Allaaha yaa ulil-albaabi la-allakum tuflihoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tas'aloo an ashyaa'a in tubda lakum tasu'ukum wa in tas'aloo anhaa heena yunazzalul-qur'aanu tubda lakum afaa Allaahu anhaa Wallaahu ghafoorun haleem
Qad sa'alahaa qawmun min qablikum thumma asbahoo bihaa kaafireen
Maa ja'ala Allaahu min baheeratin wa laa saa'ibatin wa laa waseelatin wa laa haamin wa laakinnal-ladheena kafaroo yaftaroona alaa Allaahil-kadhiba wa aktharuhum laa ya'qiloon
Wa idhaa qeela lahum ta'aalaw ilaa maa anzala Allaahu wa ilar-rasooli qaaloo hasbunaa maa wajadnaa alayhi aabaa'anaa awalaw kaana aabaa'uuhum laa ya'lamoona shay'an wa laa yahtadoon
Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo alaykum anfusakum laa yadurrukum man dalla idhah-tadaytum ilaa Allaahi marji'ukum jamee'an fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo shahaadatu baynikum idhaa hadara ahadakumul-mawtu heenal-wasiyyati ithnaani dhawaa adlin minkum aw aakharaani min ghayrikum in antum darabtum fil-ardi fa-asaabatkum museebatul-mawti tahbisoonahumaa min ba'dis-salaati fayuqsimaani Billaahi inir-tabtum laa nashtaree bihi thamanan wa law kaana dhaa qurbaa wa laa naktumu shahaadata Allaahi innaa idhan laminal-aathimeen

Fa-in uthira alaa annahumaa istahaqqaa ithman fa-aakharaani yaqoomaani maqaamahumaa minal-ladheena istahaqqa alayhimul-awlayaani fayuqsimaani Billaahi lashahaadatunaa ahaqqu min shahaadatihimaa wa ma-tadaynaa innaa idhan laminaz-zaalimeen
Dhaalika adnaa an ya'too bish-shahaadati alaa wajhihaa aw yakhaafoo an turadda aymaanun ba'da aymaanihim wattaqoo Allaaha wasma'oo Wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-faasiqeen
Yawma yajma'u Allaahur-rusula fayaqoolu maadhaa ujibtum qaaloo laa ilma lanaa innaka anta allaamul-ghuyoob

Idh qaala Allaahu yaa eesab-na maryama udhkur ni'matee alayka wa alaa wa-datika idh ayyadttuka biroohil-qudusi tukallimun-naasa fil-mahdi wa kahlan wa idh allamtukal-kitaaba wal-hikmata wat-tawraata wal-injeela wa idh takhluqu minat-teeni kahay'atit-tayri bi-idhnee fatanfukhu feehaa fatakoonu tayran bi-idhnee wa tubri'ul-akmaha wal-abrasa bi-idhnee wa idh tukhrijul-mawtaa bi-idhnee wa idh kafaftu banee israa'eela anka idh ji'tahum bil-bayyinaati faqaalal-ladheena kafaroo minhum in haadhaa illaa sihrun mubeen
Wa idh awhaytu ilal-hawaariyyeena an aaminoo bee wa birasoolee qaaloo aamannaa washhad bi-annanaa muslimoon
Idh qaalal-hawaariyyoona yaa eesab-na maryama hal yastatee'u rabbuka an yunazzila alaynaa maa'idatan minas-samaa'i qaalat-taqoo Allaaha in kuntum mu'mineen
Qaaloo nureedu an na'kula minhaa wa tatma'inna quloobunaa wa na'lama an qad sadaqtanaa wa nakoona alayhaa minash-shaahideen
Qaala eesab-nu maryama Allaahumma rabbanaa anzil alaynaa maa'idatan minas-samaa'i takoonu lanaa eedan li'wwalinaa wa aakhirinaa wa aayatan minka warzuqnaa wa anta khayrur-raaziqeen
Qaala Allaahu innee munazziluhaa alaykum faman yakfur ba'du minkum fa-innee u'adhdhibuhu adhaaban laa u'adhdhibuhu ahadan minal-aalameen

Wa idh qaala Allaahu yaa eesab-na maryama a'anta qulta lin-naasi ittakhidhoonee wa ummiya ilahayni min doonillaahi qaala subhaanaka maa yakoonu lee an aqoola maa laysa lee bihaqqin in kuntu qultuhu faqad alimtahu ta'lamu maa fee nafsee wa laa a'lamu maa fee nafsika innaka anta allaamul-ghuyoob

Maa qultu lahum illaa maa amartanee bihi ani-budoo Allaaha rabbee wa rabbakum wa kuntu alayhim shaheedan maa dumtu feehim falammaa tawaffaytanee kunta antar-raqeeba alayhim wa anta alaa kulli shay'in shaheed
In tu'adhdhibhum fa-innahum ibaaduka wa in taghfir lahum fa-innaka antal-azeezul-hakeem
Qaala Allaahu haadhaa yawmu yanfa'us-saadiqeena sidquhum lahum jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadan radiya Allaahu anhum wa radoo anhu dhaalikal-fawzul-azeem
Lillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa maa feehinna wa huwa alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
